about.seoDescription: Learn what CineTrekker is, who it is for, and how recommendations and tracking work.
about.title: About CineTrekker
about.intro: CineTrekker is a movie and TV companion for discovering what to watch, organizing your lists, and tracking your progress over time.
about.feature1: Search and explore trending, popular, upcoming, and top-rated titles.
about.feature2: Create watchlists, mark items as watched, and rate what you finish.
about.feature3: Review your watch history and personal viewing insights.
about.feature4: Adjust theme, accessibility, and content safety preferences.
about.dataSourcesDesc: Movie and TV metadata, artwork, and related information are provided by TMDB. If you create an account, your lists and preferences are saved so your experience is available across sessions and devices.
about.productGoalDesc: CineTrekker is built to make movie and TV discovery simple, structured, and personal while keeping controls clear and respectful of user preferences.

terms.seoDescription: Terms governing use of CineTrekker, including acceptable use and account responsibilities.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using CineTrekker, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
terms.acceptableUseDesc: You agree not to misuse CineTrekker, attempt unauthorized access, interfere with platform operation, or use the service for unlawful activity.
terms.accountsDesc: You are responsible for account credentials and activity under your account. Keep your sign-in details secure and notify support if you suspect unauthorized access.
terms.thirdPartyDesc: CineTrekker uses third-party data providers, including TMDB, for title metadata and imagery. Availability, accuracy, and content are subject to those providers and their terms.
terms.changesDesc: Terms may be updated from time to time. Continued use of CineTrekker after updates means you accept the revised terms.

cookies.seoDescription: How CineTrekker uses cookies and local storage to keep the app functional and personalized.
cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This policy explains how CineTrekker uses cookies and local storage technologies to keep the app secure and personalized.
cookies.store1: Authentication and session state to keep you signed in.
cookies.store2: UI and accessibility preferences such as theme, language, and font size.
cookies.store3: Feature flags and local settings used for app performance and stability.
cookies.whyWeUseItDesc: These technologies help remember your preferences, maintain account security, and provide a consistent experience between visits.
cookies.managingDesc: You can clear cookies and local storage from your browser settings at any time. Doing so may sign you out and reset saved preferences.
